headline: Loss deepens on hedge swings; pending buyout freezes payouts
summary_short: Brighthouse posted a Q1 2026 net loss of $766M (EPS -$13.82) vs a $268M loss a year ago, as revenue fell to $1,527M from $2,390M on a swing to net derivative losses. BHF still awaits regulatory sign-off on its $70.00/share cash acquisition by Aquarian Holdings.
summary_long: Revenue was $1,527M, down from $2,390M y/y, driven by net derivative gains/losses swinging to a $509M loss from a $311M gain. Pretax loss widened to $1.0B ($792M available to shareholders after preferred dividends) from $382M ($294M) a year earlier, driven by higher losses on variable annuity guaranteed-benefit-rider hedges and ULSG interest-rate derivative losses, partly offset by USD-strengthening FX gains and smaller mortgage-loan credit losses. Effective tax rate was 23% vs 25%. Cash fell to $4,907M q/q. No common buybacks or dividends this quarter; both are contractually barred while its $70.00/share cash merger with Aquarian Holdings — stockholder-approved and HSR-cleared — awaits insurance-regulator sign-off, expected to close in 2026.

drivers.explanation: Decline driven by net derivative gains (losses) swinging to a $509M loss from a $311M gain, plus lower net investment income ($1,258M vs $1,297M) and lower universal life/investment-type policy fees ($533M vs $543M).

Primarily reflects unfavorable changes in variable annuity and Shield hedges and the fair value of variable annuity guaranteed benefit riders net of Shield embedded derivatives due to market factors, plus net investment losses on fixed maturity sales, partly offset by favorable pre-tax adjusted earnings.

Driven by higher losses from variable annuity guaranteed benefit riders and losses on ULSG interest-rate derivatives as long-term rates rose; partly offset by USD strengthening benefiting FX forwards/swaps and smaller mortgage-loan credit losses.

Not explained in the release beyond the hedge/reserve items above; the company issued no forward guidance this quarter. Its pending $70.00/share cash acquisition by Aquarian Holdings (announced Nov 2025, stockholder-approved, HSR-cleared, awaiting insurance regulatory approval, expected to close 2026) bars common buybacks and dividends during the pendency.
